endpoints.correction: This recorded internalName df7ddff1-9275-4f23-acf6-e169525f4e2f with the note 'Reuses the ECM_DOCS_INTAKE workflow id.' That was wrong, and it was the single fact behind open item 37. It came from one export file, CG_Upload_Endpoint__df7ddff1-...__full_definition.json, which carried CG_Upload_Endpoint's DEFINITION stamped with ECM_DOCS_INTAKE's workflow id. A legacy export package taken from the tenant on 2026-09-03 states the flow's own resource id: df82e331-b800-4a8d-996e-d2b2ca846c77. The two definitions share 8 of 9 top-level actions; ECM_DOCS_INTAKE's shares none. They are two flows, and the bridge was never overwritten.

changelog.what: UPLOAD internalName corrected from df7ddff1 to df82e331; five CG_* endpoints re-exported from the tenant.

Every key names its adopted flow (registers/flow-adoption.json): STATUS, VERIFY, VERIFY_CONFIRM, WRITEBACK and SUPPORT move from the predecessor CG_* flows (retired, registers/flow-retirement.json) to the CG_Portal_* flows. Workflow ids are the trigger ids in registers/endpoint-register.json current_configuration, the same rows that name these flows. The predecessor each one replaces is kept under supersedes.
